question: ABCD is a trapezium in which BC || AD and AC = CD If angle ABC = 40° and angle BAC = 120° then what is the measure of angleACD (in degree)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In ΔABC, the sum of angles is 180° ⇒ ∠BCA = 180° − (120° + 40°) = 20°.

Since BC || AD, alternate interior angles are equal ⇒ ∠CAD = ∠BCA = 20°.

In ΔACD, given AC = CD ⇒ angles opposite to equal sides are equal.

Therefore, ∠ADC = ∠CAD = 20°.

Using the angle sum property in ΔACD ⇒ ∠ACD = 180° − (20° + 20°) = 140°.

**∴ The correct answer is 140°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

ABCD is a trapezium with BC || AD.

AC = CD, ∠ABC = 40°, and ∠BAC = 120°.

**Calculations:**

In ΔABC, the sum of all interior angles is always 180°.

⇒ ∠ABC + ∠BAC + ∠BCA = 180°

⇒ 40° + 120° + ∠BCA = 180°

⇒ ∠BCA = 180° − 160° = 20°

Given that BC || AD, the alternate interior angles across the transversal AC are equal.

⇒ ∠CAD = ∠BCA = 20°

In ΔACD, it is given that sides AC and CD are equal in length (AC = CD).

Angles opposite to equal sides of a triangle are equal to each other.

⇒ ∠ADC = ∠CAD = 20°

Now, applying the angle sum property in ΔACD:

⇒ ∠ACD + ∠CAD + ∠ADC = 180°

⇒ ∠ACD + 20° + 20° = 180°

⇒ ∠ACD + 40° = 180°

⇒ ∠ACD = 140°

**∴ The correct answer is 140°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Isosceles Triangle Property

If two sides of a triangle are equal, then the angles opposite to those sides are also perfectly equal in measure.

Alternate Interior Angles Theorem

When a transversal line intersects two parallel lines, the alternate interior angles formed on opposite sides of the transversal are equal.

Angle Sum Property

The sum of all three internal angles of any standard planar triangle will always exactly equal 180°.

Properties of a Trapezium

A trapezium features exactly one pair of parallel sides. The adjacent interior angles between these parallel sides sum up to 180°.
